visualCharacteristics: Vertical stack of promotional image links. Each is a clickable image banner linking to a promotional page.
contentPattern: Each row is one promotional banner. Column 1: promotional image. Column 2: link to promotional page (the entire card becomes clickable).
usage: Use for displaying a vertical stack of clickable promotional banners in a sidebar or rail.
reuseGuidance: Each card row should have a promotional banner image in the first cell and a link in the second cell.
